invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null list constructed by .collect(Collectors.toList()), which never produces null.
The elements in 'result' come from 'getFileId()' of each FileSlice, which should not be null for existing files.
The result list is constructed using '.distinct()', so all elements should be unique.
If result is empty, that means there were no slices for the partitionPath; in other words, the stream produces nothing.
Because the method passes partitionPath to the underlying HoodieTable API, which expects a non-null partition.
